Eva bought a coat at the shop yesterday. Eva hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Eva thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Best of all, she is interested in ancient history.
Ben is interested in drawing. They took many photos at the class meeting. The picnic ground is one of the best places in the city. In fact, he was unwilling to share his toys with his cousin.
Eva's favorite animal is the rabbit. The weather was rainy that day. There are always many people at the class meeting. The kid grinned from ear to ear.
Both of them like rice and coffee. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Eva plays table tennis with Ben every Tuesday.
